quote: BLEU and ROUGE are used to evaluate the explanation task.
BLEU and ROUGE are used to evaluate the explanation task. The larger value of BLEU and ROUGE indicates better explainability.

BLEU and ROUGE are used to evaluate the explanation task. ROUGE's evaluation is based on the co-occurrence information of n-grams in the text. ROUGE-N (N=1,2) mainly counts on the N-grams. ROUGE-L is calculated by matching the longest common subsequence. ROUGE-SU4 is calculated by the skipgram strategy...
